name: Roundtable
description: A space's discussion plus two prioritized idea boards. Editors chat in a single channel, add items to a Positives list (features, tasks) or a Negatives list (issues, bugs), and +1 the ones that matter; items rank by votes, then recency. Editors delete their own; the owner can delete anything, renames the frame and its two lists, and chooses whether Viewer-role members may participate too (off by default). Everyone else the frame reaches, including anyone it is published to, follows along live, read-only. Messages, items and votes are the space's own tables (roundtable_messages, roundtable_items, roundtable_votes); the settings are rows of the space.
